description: Block destructive git and shell commands; generate the Git hooks .harness.json lists and install its status line; after a session in a project that keeps .about/, review it with the glossary and adr skills

hooks.command: if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/git-hooks.ts"; fi
if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/status-line.ts"; fi
if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard.ts"; fi
if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session-review.ts"; fi
